signatures.description: Two replicas of a multi-leader CRDT both compact their op logs independently; one compacted away causally-complete delta chunks still referenced transitively by a third replica. After a network heal, the merged state violates observed delivery invariants even though each replica individually applied valid ops. Explain the convergence failure mechanism and the minimal log-retention/metadata rule that guarantees convergence without unbounded tombstones.
